proposal.ranking: Greedy newly covered seed pixels, equal total weight per nonempty predicted class; deterministic lexicographic tie break
proposal.empty_prediction_policy: No ROI; keep coarse prediction, no silent ground-truth or full-frame fallback

evaluation.input_protocol: PIL RGB bilinear to256; mean logits softmax; FP32 bilinear probabilities to untouched native GT grid align_corners=false
evaluation.decision: ROI feasibility only, not segmentation acceptance. Meet all coverage/cost constraints before proposing bounded crop-training protocol; no threshold adjustment after results
evaluation.oracle: Perfect correction of valid GT pixels inside automatically proposed ROI union only; diagnostic upper bound, never a real model result or GT-selected ROI

benchmark.scope: Cached native RGB/PIL coarse inference, CPU ROI proposal, sequential resized crop model calls, native probability remapping and CPU crop outputs; no decode/display/fusion/geometry/memory
benchmark.proxy: Reuse frozen coarse U-Net as same-shape compute proxy only; not a trained crop refiner and no crop accuracy claim

config.constraints: Validation29 frames only; no training images or reserve800 read; zero training/parameter updates/pseudo labels. stone_new excluded. Source/case and unreviewed training-label limitations preserved
